title: Contingency Placement Agreements: Waiver of Recent Late Charges in a Closing Settlement
content:
**Rule.** In the closing settlement payment on an agreement under the Contingency Placement Agreements, late charges booked on the agreement in the 12 months before the payment are waived from the payment in full where exactly one late charge was booked in those 12 months, by half (0.5 of their total) where exactly two were booked, and not at all otherwise.

**Effect.** The waiver is taken off the agreement's fees owed itself; every amount taken off the payment is taken off that same fees owed, the payment is never less than zero, and it is rounded to the cent once at the end. The waiver is cleared by credit on the closing statement.

## Points of judgement

**Which late charges are counted and waived?**
The late-charge entries booked on the agreement — across all of its invoices — with a date in the 12 months before the payment. A window of a number of months before a date covers the dates after the same day that number of months earlier, up to and including that date; here the window ends on the day of the payment.

**What is waived where exactly one late charge was booked in the window?**
That late charge in full.

**Where exactly two were booked?**
Half of the total of those two.

**Where none, or three or more, were booked?**
Nothing is waived.

## Hypothetical figures

Payment on 2026-10-05; window from 2025-10-06 through 2026-10-05.

| Late charges in the window | Their total | Waiver |
|---|---|---|
| one, of 37.50 USD | 37.50 USD | 37.50 USD |
| two, of 37.50 USD and 41.10 USD | 78.60 USD | 39.30 USD |
| three, totalling 120.00 USD | 120.00 USD | nothing |

A late charge booked on 2025-10-05 lies outside this window and is neither counted nor waived.
